facts.business: Richfield Financial Services Limited is an NBFC registered with RBI, primarily engaged in lending activities with a growing focus on Gold Loans and other retail lending products.

segments.name: Personal Loans and other loan products

capacity_or_capex.timeline: FY 2025-26 (from 19 to 50 branches, including 9 in Bangalore)

guidance_or_targets.statement: Working towards achieving Gold Loan AUM of ₹150 crore
Exploring a public issue of Non-Convertible Debentures

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on Note 2.(v) regarding interest income recognition on NPA accounts

key_risks: Increasing competition from banks, NBFCs and fintech companies
Changes in regulatory and compliance requirements
Changes in interest rates and borrowing costs
Volatility in gold prices and its impact on the value of collateral
